meta.title: RF Plasma Source (XHS‑RFIS)
meta.description: Starthermatech provides XHS-RFIS RF coupled plasma source complete equipment (RF/ICP) with no DC electrodes, delivering stable low-contamination ion beams. Supports Ar/He/N₂ and multiple propellant gases, suitable for materials processing, plasma chemistry, and laboratory platforms. Customizable power, frequency, and flange interfaces, easy integration with beam diagnostic systems, supporting equipment procurement and custom solution consulting.

page.lead: RF-coupled, compact, customizable power/frequency for research and process use.
detail.title: RF Ion Source XHS‑RFIS
detail.tagline: Modular RF-coupled ion source, low contamination, easy integration
detail.overview: RF/ICP-based source with no DC electrodes, compact and easy to maintain. Supports multiple gases for materials processing and plasma chemistry, or as a lab/process ion source; integrates well with diagnostics for beam/density calibration.
detail.feature1: RF coupling without DC electrodes for low contamination and easy upkeep
detail.feature2: Supports Ar/He/N₂ and more with easy tuning
detail.feature3: Compact form with configurable power/frequency and cooling options
detail.feature4: Easy pairing with probes/Faraday/RPA for beam diagnostics
